intro: Everything here is named company → version → piece. "v1" is always a version of a company. Comment like "eBay v1 recap, shot 03: …". The top section needs your review; everything below it is already built and kept for reference.

scenes.title: Tesla v1 · Logo sting
scenes.note: Bookended by the 3D "Cybercab" lettering in champagne metal on dark, with two fast photo cuts in between. Transitions are deliberately edgy: glitch slices between photos, a light-bar flash in and out of 3D.

shots.d: Dark void. The white T sits above; below it, the 3D lettering spins in, a thin champagne sliver with one warm glint running along it. Low hum.
Light-bar flash: a bright horizontal line sweeps across and flashes white into the night-fog photo of the light bar, which pushes in slowly.

Transition, shown mid-cut: glitch slice. The frame tears into horizontal bands that slide past each other with a red/cyan fringe and a white scan line, for about 4 frames. Sharp digital crunch on the sound.
The aero wheel in macro (photo), with a light sweep across it.

Light-bar flash back into the void: the 3D Cybercab sits low, light bar glowing; the lettering swings round to face you and settles above it; the white T and TESLA wordmark fade in at the top. Hold to 4.0s.

scenes.title: Tesla v1 · 15s promo
scenes.note: Photography where it matters (Tesla's night-street images), 3D where photos can't go (the map-to-satellite dive, the charging pad). Cuts are edgy: glitch slices between photos, a spray-slash wipe (a sprayed diagonal stroke rips across and reveals the next shot) going into the map, and light-bar flashes in and out of 3D. Sound: city ambience, soft electric passes, a digital crunch on each glitch, a warm pulse under the end card.

shots.d: A phone with the Robotaxi app: "Where to?" → Summon. A champagne pulse ripples out from the tap. "Tap."
Light-bar flash out of the app into the night street in fog (photo), slow push in. "It comes to you."
Glitch slice into the doors lifting on a city street (photo), with a slow drift. "Every seat is a passenger seat."
Spray slash: a sprayed diagonal stroke rips across the photo and the dark map shows through it. The route draws in champagne. "No driver. Just the route."
The camera dives toward the car and the map dissolves into satellite view (same streets: rooftops, trees, crosswalks), with the car following the glowing route.
Glitch slice back to street level: it pulls away from a lit café street (photo). "Drops you off. Keeps working."
Parked over a softly glowing charging pad, which pulses warm. "Charges itself. Inductive charging, no plug."
Light-bar flash into the end card on Tesla's amber studio photo: white T, TESLA wordmark, and the sprayed "Cybercab" drawing on. Hold.

scenes.title: Tesla v1 · Social loop
scenes.note: The 3D "Cybercab" lettering spins a slow full 360° behind the car, champagne metal in a dark void. The car sits in front in low light. The spin ends where it began, so the loop joins invisibly.

shots.d: Darkness. The lettering is edge-on: a thin champagne sliver catching one warm glint. Below it, the car's silhouette, its light bar barely on. A low hum.
The lettering turns to face you and a light sweep runs across the metal strokes. The car's light bar glows full, lighting the floor. A soft chime.
It keeps turning, back side catching a long glint, while the light bar eases down. It returns to edge-on at 6.0s: a seamless loop.

sections.title: Already built · Launch post and v1 recaps

scenes.title: Launch post · Thumbnail
scenes.meta: 1920×1080 still · the post's thumbnail and social card
scenes.note: The site's own look, since the post introduces the site. Headline on the left, the eBay and Google work fanned on the right, and the URL. It has to read at small sizes (LinkedIn and Substack cards), so the text is big.

shots.d: Final thumbnail. Saved to share/launch/thumbnail-1920x1080.png.

scenes.title: Launch post · Video
scenes.note: Plays at the top of the post. It reuses the site's own motion: the headline wave and the turning carousel. Soft keys underneath; it also works muted.

shots.d: Black. Your N mark draws on, then "Motion" sets beside it. "by noletorious" fades in below. A soft key note.
The headline sets in: "Exploring motion," with the letters of "motion" rippling in the gradient (the same animation as the site), then "by company" below.
The headline lifts away and the carousel turns into view, slowly, with each company's v1 work. The caption under it updates as cards pass the front.
Cut in to full-frame eBay v1 for about 1.5s, playing live, with a mono tag.
Whip to full-frame Google v1 for about 1.5s, with its tag.
"One company. Many takes." Two columns: v1 lit (built), and v2 and v3 dim (coming), listed by name. This is the plan in one frame.
End: motion.noletorious.com, then your mark and "by noletorious". Holds about 2s, then loops cleanly back to black.

scenes.title: eBay v1 · Recap (9:16)
scenes.note: Built from the v1 Bright Bounce pieces. On eBay's own white, the same colour as its pieces, with Motion's type. Posting asset only; it won't appear on the website.

shots.d: Hook. "eBay," sets in word by word in Fraunces, then "in motion" ripples in with the logo gradient. The four brand dots drop in and bounce (borrowed from the v1 sting). Soft pluck on each dot.
"01 · Logo sting". The frame slides up from below and the sting plays inside it at full speed. The label types on in mono.
"02 · 15s promo". Two frames stack: the top one plays the promo's opening, and the lower one jumps ahead to a feature scene, showing the range in one beat. Cuts land on the promo's own beat.
"03 · Social loop". A square frame grows in and the loop plays one full cycle.
Collage. All three frames fall into a tilted stack, still playing. "Three pieces. All code." sets in below. Whoosh into the stack, soft thump on landing.
End card. Your N mark and "Motion", then motion.noletorious.com, then a "Next → v2 Super Live" chip that pulses once. Holds for about 2s, so the loop reads clean on Reels.

scenes.title: Google v1 · Recap (9:16)
scenes.note: Same template on Google's white, with its v1 Soft Material pieces. Posting asset only. Google's dots spin into place instead of bouncing, echoing its sting.

shots.d: Hook. "Google," sets in word by word in Fraunces, then "in motion" ripples in with the logo gradient. The four brand dots spin in and settle (borrowed from the v1 sting). Soft pluck on each dot.
"01 · Logo sting". The frame slides up from below and the sting plays inside it at full speed. The label types on in mono.
"02 · 15s promo". Two frames stack: the top one plays the promo's opening, and the lower one jumps ahead to a feature scene, showing the range in one beat. Cuts land on the promo's own beat.
"03 · Social loop". A square frame grows in and the loop plays one full cycle.
Collage. All three frames fall into a tilted stack, still playing. "Three pieces. All code." sets in below. Whoosh into the stack, soft thump on landing.
End card. Your N mark and "Motion", then motion.noletorious.com, then a "Next → v2 Gemini Redesign" chip that pulses once. Holds for about 2s, so the loop reads clean on Reels.

scenes.title: Home
scenes.note: Quiet frame: near-black, off-white, Instrument Serif headline, mono labels. The only colour on the page comes from the company tiles.

shots.d: The headline sets in line by line, 80ms apart. Tiles fade up from 12px below. Each tile shows a poster still; no iframes load yet.

On hover the eBay tile's poster crossfades to its featured piece, playing muted and looping, with a mono timecode chip top-left. The other tile dims to 40%. The iframe mounts on first hover and stays mounted after that.

scenes.title: Company page — eBay
scenes.note: Transition from home: the clicked tile's poster grows into the hero reel (View Transitions, shared element, 0.5s), and the name rises in under it.

shots.d: Name in huge serif, description, then key facts in a mono row, each with its value. Below that the hero reel autoplays at full width, muted, with a sound toggle.
Every piece in pieces/, each labelled by type, length and aspect. Clicking a piece plays it with sound. Square pieces sit in a narrower column. Footer: spec work, not affiliated.

scenes.title: Logo sting
scenes.note: Idea: four dots drop in like bids landing, then become the letters.

shots.d: White frame. Red, blue and yellow dots drop in from above, staggered 120ms apart, leaving soft motion trails. A pitched pluck sounds as each one lands.
The green dot joins. All four squash on landing and bounce once, out of phase, like a crowd of bids.
Each dot stretches upward and the letters e b a y rise out of it, revealed bottom to top. The dots shrink away as the letters fill.
Wordmark settles with a small overshoot. "Things people love." fades up beneath it. One soft low thump, then hold to 4.0s.

scenes.title: 15s promo
scenes.note: Structure: hook → product → numbers → features → how it works → numbers → CTA. Music: an upbeat 120 bpm pluck bed with cuts on the beat (every 2 bars ≈ 2s).

shots.d: Hard cut in. "Things / people / love." slams in one word per beat. "love." lands in red. The small wordmark sits top-left for the whole piece.
Whip pan right onto an endless shelf of listings, with motion blur on the edge cards. Prices tick up on the bid items. The line reads "Bid on it. Or buy it now."
Cut to white. "134M" counts up in blue over 0.5s, then holds. "active buyers" and an underline wipe in.
The sneaker card slides in. A green check badge stamps on with a short shake and a click. "Authenticity Guarantee" sets in beside it.
A blue field wipes across. The shield draws on and the $ pops. "Money Back Guarantee" and its one-line promise appear.
The three steps cascade in left to right, 0.3s apart: the photo snaps with a flash, the listing text shimmers as it drafts, and a "You sold an item!" notification drops in.
"$75B" counts up. The yellow bar sweeps under it. "in goods sold on eBay in 2024".
End card. The wordmark scales down from oversized, then the tagline and CTA pill appear. Hold 1.5s. The music resolves on the final beat.

scenes.title: Social loop
scenes.note: A three-second auction, forever. Last frame matches the first.

shots.d: A price tag swings gently on its string over eBay yellow. The bid sits at $42 and the timer reads 0:03.
Bids flood in as "+ bid" bubbles from all sides in the brand colours. The price ticks up fast and the tag sways harder.
The timer hits zero. A red SOLD stamp slams in with a thud. The tag spins 360° on its string, the stamp falls away, and the price resets to $42, matching frame 1.

scenes.title: Logo sting
scenes.note: Idea: Google's four dots, "thinking", resolve into the G and then the wordmark.

shots.d: Four dots (blue, red, yellow, green) bob in a wave, like something is listening. A soft rising tone plays.
The dots whip into a ring and spin, stretching into arcs as they speed up.
The arcs lock into the four-colour G and the crossbar slides in. A clean chime plays.
The G morphs into the capital of the wordmark, and o-o-g-l-e type on to the right, 60ms apart. Hold to 4.0s.

scenes.title: 15s promo
scenes.note: Structure: hook → scale → number → three features → number → CTA. Music: light piano and soft synth, warmer than eBay.

shots.d: A search bar alone on white. "why is the sky" types in with key clicks, and the cursor blinks.
The camera pulls back fast. The bar shrinks into a sea of other people's searches in many languages, all drifting slowly.
All the pills collapse to a point. "5T+" counts up in blue, "searches a year" sets in, and four colour dashes draw under it.
A long question appears in a soft bubble. The AI Mode answer streams in line by line with a ✦, then the source chips pop in.
A phone slides in on a plant. Lens corners snap to the leaf and the result card rises: "Monstera deliciosa".
Hard cut to a map. The blue route draws from start to pin in 1.2s and the pin drops with a bounce. "Get there."
"6" lands big. Six shapes pop in a 3×2 grid, 70ms apart: "products, each used by more than 2 billion people".
End card. The wordmark appears, then the search bar types "Start at google.com". Hold 1.5s.

scenes.title: Social loop
scenes.note: Four soft shapes play musical chairs. Last frame matches the first.

shots.d: Four shapes in a 2×2 grid: a blue circle, a red rounded square, a yellow triangle and a green pill. Each breathes very slightly.
The shapes orbit one step clockwise, morphing toward each other's form as they pass, with a soft whoosh.
They pull into a tight cluster of four circles, the shapes rounding off as they meet, then spring back out to the 2×2 grid. The loop restarts.
